theme_and_archetype.description: Deep, warm, and ceremonial. The design must feel like a brass-lit garbhagudi (sanctum) at night. Inspired by Rameshwaram Cafe's aesthetic but adapted for a sacred, ancient context.

rules: NO purple, NO neon orange, NO pure black, NO pure white.
Readability is CRITICAL: Text on deep canvas MUST be text_cream (#F3EAD8) or brighter. Text on ivory canvas MUST be text_deep_brown (#2A1810).
No mid-grey beige that makes text disappear. Strictly adhere to the Garbhagudi (dark) and Sandstone (light) modes.
Use italic accents in display English headings for elegance (e.g., Sri Balanjaneya Swamy).
Always pair Kannada eyebrow (marigold) with English display (cream) for bilingual sections.
Line height for body text should be loose (leading-relaxed).

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Calm, uncrowded, and generous. Sections should feel like turning pages of an ancient book.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Ornamental hairline borders on sections and modals, mimicking a brass-lit frame (1px solid border_warm).
layout_and_spacing.canvas_strategy: Alternate between Deep Canvas (majority) and Ivory Canvas (for specific storytelling like Rama Mantra to provide contrast).

motion_and_interactions.hero_parallax: Subtle, slow parallax on hero photos. Smooth and ceremonial, never aggressive.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Staggered fade-up and slow translate-y for text and images entering the viewport.
motion_and_interactions.stotra_ribbon: Continuous, very slow marquee scrolling at the top.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Delicate, slow opacity changes or slight scaling (1.02) on images. No bouncy or playful animations.

hero.layout: Full-bleed dramatic background image with heavy overlay (e.g., bg-[#0E0B08]/60) so text is 100% readable.
hero.content: Large display serif English + Kannada. Hanuman stotra scrolling ribbon at the top. Single primary CTA (Copper stroke/text). Scroll-to-explore hint text at bottom.

section_divider.style: A central ornamental mandala/tilak motif with hairline copper rules extending horizontally.

before_after_diptych.style: Two side-by-side vertical images (or stacked on mobile) with hairline copper borders, showing the unadorned vs adorned idol. Use subtle labels.

rsvp_contact_form.style: No white inputs on dark background. Use dark transparent inputs (bg-[#1A120A]) with copper borders. Minimalist. Submit button: solid copper or copper outline.

believed_blessings_card.style: Flat surface (bg-[#1A120A] or bg-[#F9F2DF]), 1px copper border. No heavy drop shadows. Generous internal padding (p-8).

instructions_to_main_agent: You must build the entire site using this exact colour palette mapped into tailwind.config.js.
Ensure WCAG AA contrast by strictly enforcing text_cream on canvas_deep, and text_deep_brown on canvas_ivory.
Include both English and Kannada copy as requested. DO NOT use placeholder text.
Implement the 'Before & After' diptych asset explicitly as a critical story element.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
The footer must be deep brown (#2A1810) with cream text (#F3EAD8) to ensure it is readable.
The background must not use typical gradient-purple AI-slop; stick to the anthracite/copper/ivory palette.
Use pure HTML and Tailwind for layout structures; you may use Shadcn for forms (RSVP, contact), but heavily customized to the temple theme.
DO NOT build a payment gateway, admin panel, or third-party integrations.
